name: Apatura Ltd
ownership_summary: Energy infrastructure developer founded 2014 (per press); Companies House entity Apatura Ltd incorporated 2022. Press coverage credits the group with a 10.6 GW grid-secured portfolio including 1.8 GW of grid connections targeting data centre developments; corporate site claims access to 10 GW of renewable energy capacity.

name: Apatura DC Project 3 Ltd
ownership_summary: Active company incorporated 2024-10-28, registered at 3rd Floor 1 Ashley Road, Altrincham WA14 2DT — the same address as a numbered series of Apatura DC Project SPVs. Attributed as the Coldstream project vehicle by Data Center Dynamics; not confirmed against primary planning documents.
notes: SPV-to-site attribution rests on journalism (tier 4); screening documents were not retrievable to confirm the named applicant.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: Tracks the Coldstream proposal on its national data centre map; director Dr Kat Jones described such developments as a threat requiring public awareness.
